capabilities: Search glossary terms in English or Spanish, with or without accents
Show plain, technical and example definitions for each term
Hover underlined glossary terms in reading mode to preview their card
Add custom terms as notes in a Why Glossary folder
Study the glossary with flashcard sessions that repeat missed cards
disambiguation: Not a translation tool; it looks up predefined glossary terms rather than translating arbitrary text.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It makes no network requests, has no account or paid tier, and is MIT-licensed; the base glossary installs itself into a Why Glossary/ folder and never overwrites edited term notes.
motivation: The author built it because half the words in tech, product and data are English and most explanations of them assume you already know them.
problem: Tech vocabulary is mostly English and its explanations assume prior knowledge, so Spanish-speaking users have no quick in-vault reference that explains terms in plain words in either language.

relations.evidence: Install Obsidian42 - BRAT from the community plugins.

summary: Bilingual English–Spanish glossary with ~400 preloaded term notes, two-level definitions, hover cards in reading mode, custom terms and flashcard study.
